purpose: Add the built-in Arabic keyboard without changing the interface language or replacing other keyboards
upstream_prerequisite: /usr/share/kodi/system/keyboardlayouts/arabic.xml must declare layout language Arabic and layout QWERTY
apply: Read current value with Settings.GetSettingValue and retain a private before record
Preserve the existing ordered list and append Arabic QWERTY only if absent
Apply through Settings.SetSettingValue while Kodi is running; do not edit guisettings.xml under a running Kodi
Read back the runtime value and verify the saved locale.keyboardlayouts entry in guisettings.xml
Keep locale.language, skin/fonts, account, network and addon source receipts unchanged

local_acceptance.on_screen_keyboard_switch: not tested during requested episode playback

remote_acceptance: Applicable additive policy; not deployed in this operation. Preserve that device's own existing layouts.
user_action: Use the keyboard dialog's layout/language selector to switch between enabled English and Arabic layouts
updates: Include this native setting in each device's own userdata backup and selectively merge it when provisioning a new box; no custom keyboard addon or source patch is needed
rollback: Restore only the recorded previous ordered layout list using Settings.SetSettingValue, preserving any later user-added layouts after review
